name: Grade 7 IT Practice: March Week 2 - mBlock Workspace
description: Practice words for mBlock tools and first scripts.

words.definition: A block coding tool used to program the mBot.
words.example: The student opened mBlock to program the mBot.

words.definition: The area in a program where you do your work.
words.example: The movement blocks were arranged in the workspace.

words.definition: A character or object in a Scratch or mBlock project.
words.example: The sprite on the screen copied the robot movement.

words.definition: A coding command that snaps into a program.
words.example: The forward block made the robot drive ahead.

words.definition: A group of connected blocks that run together.
words.example: The script connected start, move, and stop blocks.

words.definition: To send a program from the computer to the robot.
words.example: Upload sent the finished program to the mBot.

words.definition: The screen and tools used to work with a program.
words.example: The interface showed the blocks, stage, and device connection.
